seo.title: Sphera Live – Real-Time Multiplayer Quiz · CampusSphere
seo.description: Turn any course into a live multiplayer quiz. Join with a simple PIN code on your smartphone, compete with classmates, and top the leaderboard.

hero.subtitle: Whether studying for a medical exam in an auditorium or hosting a movie blind test on a Saturday night: start your game in 30 seconds, share a PIN, and challenge friends in real time.

mockup.quizTitle: General Quiz: Law, Science & Pop Culture
mockup.sampleQuestion: In which year was the first GPT language model released by OpenAI?

ways.title: 3 simple ways to create a game
ways.subtitle: Generate your quiz in seconds according to your inspiration.

way1.title: Generate with AI
way1.description: Drag & drop your lecture notes (PDF, Word, TXT) or paste a CampusSphere resource URL. AI extracts essentials and constructs the quiz instantly.
way1.tag: Supports PDF up to 50 MB & direct links

way2.title: Manual Creation
way2.description: Maintain total control: write each question, 4 choices, choose the correct answer, and calibrate the time limit (10 to 60s) to fit difficulty.
way2.tag: Ideal for custom quizzes & blind tests

way3.title: JSON Import
way3.description: Import a structured JSON file. Sphera populates the visual editor immediately to let you preview and fine-tune every question before takeoff.

universes.title: Two universes, the same adrenaline
universes.subtitle: Sphera Live adapts equally well to university finals and weekend game nights.

study.title: Active Recall gone multiplayer
study.description: Cognitive neuroscience proves that timed recall in a social context triples long-term retention compared to passive rereading.
study.item1: Perfect for seminars, lecture halls, and library study groups
study.item2: Instant identification of concepts misunderstood across the cohort
study.item3: Realistic training under exam countdown pressure

fun.title: Board games reinvented on screen
fun.description: Have 10 minutes to spare or a party with friends? Launch a challenge on football, anime, world trivia, or pop culture.
fun.item1: Unusual trivia, cinema, music, sports, and geography
fun.item2: Everyone participates directly from their phone
fun.item3: Win the game and claim first place on the podium

features.title: Built for a flawless experience
features.subtitle: Every single detail is polished to maximize game thrill and hosting ease.
features.f1Desc: A simple 6-letter PIN and your connected account to jump straight into the match.
features.f2Desc: Immersive audio for ticking timer suspense, with a one-click mute button for classrooms.
features.f3Desc: Celebrate the top 3 contenders at match end with an animated shower of confetti.
features.f4Desc: A precise algorithm that rewards both speed and accurate responses.
features.f5Desc: Rerun the same session with a new group in one click without re-entering questions.
features.f6Desc: Transform any course syllabus into a competitive quiz in seconds with Sphera AI engine.

finalCta.title: Ready for the buzzer thrill?
finalCta.subtitle: Create your first Sphera Live session in 30 seconds or join your peers with their game code.
